round: separate R3 protocol, not post-official R2 tuning
selection_bias: R2 validation is exposed design data; prior official is exposed regression data, never independent R3 efficacy

G4.applies_to: positive masses, specifically final 8kg A/B; failure remains failure

timing.metric: paired controller+detector wall/thread CPU including allocation; guard outside measured methods

stability.plant: elastic joints + nominal rigid rotor armature + native viscosity/smooth Coulomb + actual local contact/weld where applicable; exact1ms ZOH;1cycle command delay; Drive PI current measured encoder and old command; JTS300Hz/1cycle; sampled encoder difference explicit
stability.controller_states: all output-affecting filters/integrators/previous samples, freeze phase/reference/discrete switches
stability.noise: unquantized derivative, noise/quantization disturbances not poles
stability.margins: structured scalar and worst-axis feedback gain scaling, not universal MIMO margin; pure FF margin N/A
stability.control_adoption: all tested active-mode pole radii<1+1e-6 and convergent FD; if R1 moving-point itself fails report it, do not transfer book guarantees

normal_detector_policy: Every changed control checked first on independent normal validation with frozen R1 detector. Extra FA -> reject OR one registered normal-only recalibration with new seed before any collision. No threshold tuning from collisions. C5 changed observer uses new normal targets/features ridge .02 and threshold max(3,1.2*max normal validation+.5), freeze before dev. Runtime numpy only; no official conditions in fit.
C3_selection: >=10% RMS or max improvement in analysis-perturbation matched development, no >5% nominal TCP/torque step regression, no lost R1 dev collision detection, no extra FA; all safety/detector/stability/timing gates
C4_selection: >=10% RMS or max improvement vs R1 and no >5% peak/step/nominal regression; all safety/detector/stability/timing gates

development.design: 2 matched references plus24 balanced signs/phases/forces, matched R1

design_derivation.A: Direct place DOB already0. Continue observer and quintic-fade correction before3.6:3.35-3.60 is1.125 observer time constants,3.10-3.60 is2.25; pre3.1 benefit retained but inherited place efficacy unknown.
design_derivation.B: Light terminal P/V feedback causes identified failures. Link-law handoff3.60 to existing UNLOAD_START3.84; mass-only comparator uses exposed3.15/5.65 boundaries; combined protects light and terminal scopes. No raw load-fraction activation.
design_derivation.B_compute: single blended-inertia pRNE action with shared kinematics/preallocated workspaces, exact endpoint M/g blending and reuse one R1 baseline; no fractional-payload model approximation, globalGC unchanged

diagnostic_exclusions.R2_anchor: known failed old anchor only in existing-observation replay/math tests, never adopt by lucky new validation
diagnostic_exclusions.early_hardoff: not implemented/evaluated for adoption: could move step outside evaluation window; full-cycle step always recorded

operational_gates.cost_rule: EVERY matched case <=1.05*same-case R1; never ratio of architecture-wide maxima; zero baseline permits zero only
operational_gates.G4_applicability: Preserve R2 selector semantics: C3/C4 report G4 thresholds/peak/pass count unchanged, no new G4 pass-count adoption requirement; G4 remains unmet unless original mean/min/increase/peak all pass.
operational_gates.efficacy_A: min(mean(per-case RMS ratio),mean(per-case max-TCP ratio))<=0.90 on preregistered matched positive-mass no-collision analysis perturbations
operational_gates.efficacy_B: R2 C4 rule: min(mean per-case validation RMS ratio,mean per-case max ratio)<=0.90
operational_gates.timing: maximum row combined wall p99<800us with self-contained candidates/R1 serial; max1000us remains goal not new automatic rejection
operational_gates.detector: R1 bytes first; no lost R1 development/official detections or tool-contact detection, no increased per-case extra/referenceFA; no collision-based calibration
operational_gates.normal_recalibration: at most1/architecture before any collision, new normal-only seed/data; if used reason recorded and parameters frozen before development; otherarchitecture inference exact; conservative reject allowed

selection.priority_reason: Only among validation cost/safety/timing and forced-point stability passes (plus B validation efficacy): predeclared more R1-preserving scope first, not best collision score.
selection.if_no_validation_eligible: best initially eligible-design cost-score setting may be diagnostic challenger for fixed development/D4/perturb, irreversibly non-adoptable; no later revival

redesign.condition: physical failure explanation recorded first, never from holdout/official, must use new validation seed; registered sweeps do not count as redesign

selection.redesign_default: If none passes and failure cost-dominated with physical explanation, use1 redesign by default; otherwise record exact contemporaneous unused reason BEFORE development
selection.redesign_artifact: PROTOCOL_R3_REDESIGN_A/B.json and cause/decision committed BEFORE new params/source,1 new setting perarchitecture on369812 conditions; originalprotocol immutable
selection.advance_rule: Advance one priority-first configuration per architecture after validation cost/safety/timing/forced stability (and B validation tracking gain). Recheck actual candidate operating-point stability before development. A perturbation efficacy is deferred. The same challenger must then pass development detection/efficacy, D4 and perturbations; no runner-up promotion after development or actual-point failure.

stability_R3.first: forced-R1 physical points for all initial/redo settings BEFORE candidate validation
stability_R3.second: actual candidate physical/controller/queue/drive snapshots from normal validation BEFORE development for adoption-eligible candidates
stability_R3.actual_peak_points: add actual TCPmax and place-step samples; weights0/.5/1 represented; all active radii<1+1e-6 and convergentFD; neutral modes marginal
stability_R3.scope: fixed-phase/fixed-contact local checks, not nonlinear/LTV/hybrid/passivity guarantee
stability_R3.mass_branch_method: Pole checks at true mass knots/midpoint; explicitly check continuous schedule weights and one-sided branch/derivative at knot+-0.001kg. Exposed R2 R1 traces at3.15/5.65 are design-only operating points, NOT reused R3 validation/efficacy;4.4 may need fresh nonofficial R1 diagnostic.

D4.design: same385/architecture R1 grid, deliberate new-split exception
D4.source_reuse: exact source/conditions hash plus fresh selected-array parity proof only; never independent rerun claim

perturbations.physical_matrix: same finite R1 analysis-only private instance matrix

holdout.gate: same per-case cost/normalFA/no lost R1 collision or tool detection/no increased outside-eventFA; never tune/promote after results
holdout.marker: exclusive fsynced marker BEFORE real RNG, verify committed source/params/weights/git objects; one batch only

freeze.fallback: Only selecting/materializing already-frozen immutable R1 bytes after failure; no candidate edits, alternative promotion or second official. This is frozen artifact selection, not tuning.

official.stage: LAST after newholdout; one A+B default-name unchanged-kit batch58episodes
official.prior_exposure: regression only, never independent efficacy or fit
official.after_failure: affectedarchitecture immutable R1 fallback; shared unidentifiedfailure bothR1; neverrepair/retune/retest

submission: self-contained my_servo/my_torque/my_detector, NumPy/MuJoCo and publicsim.config/trajectory only; no experiment imports/file I/O
